correctness.rationale: For simple Möbius M_{2m}, m≥3, cubic three-dynamic coloring equals proper vertex coloring of square. Reconstructed twisted two-row local constraints: adjacent column supports require four different colors and same-row distance-two conflicts. Four colors force c_{i+2}=swap(c_i), hence m≡2 mod4; explicit period-four construction proves sufficiency. Small M_6²=K6, M_8²=K8, and m=8 has α(M_16²)≤3 by parity and twisted seam, while a six-color word exists. Three verified five-color seeds at m=5,7,12 plus locally verified four-column insertion yield all other m≥5. Independent DSATUR exact graph-square coloring computed m=3..12 values 6,8,5,4,5,6,5,4,5,5 as claimed. The infinite m result uses structural insertion proof, not a finite search.
